notes.title: UNABLES 0.2.0.5
notes.content:
Hello playtesters! Here are some of the more important changes in the new update:

- menu now includes level list, titles and short descriptions,
- changed the order of the levels as suggested by the testers,
- you need to collect stars to unlock new levels
- added walls (visual) and new props to first level,
- dinosaur level is now an island filled with water, also you can die when touchink the bloody spears,
- detective level now has an additional 'closed door' puzzle,
- added bumpers to pro resting level,
- labirynth level has been optimised, added passages and a deadly saw,
- changed the 'sausage' goal in pool level to 'boombox' (you have to sink it, but there are some obstacles, of course),
- dracula level was visually improved (+ cats!),
- removed the slow-motion effect,
- the Mac version of playtest has been discontinued,
